reason: My Instagram account is my storefront and my proof, and this runs automated DMs through it. 'Human pace' and 'no password' don't tell me it won't get restricted, and there are no customer results anywhere. I'm not putting my main account on the line for that.
objection: Will this get my Instagram account restricted or banned? Nothing here says what happens if it does, nobody has published results, and a card-required trial that turns into final payments after day 4 makes me more cautious, not less.
would_change_my_mind: Named agency owners showing real reply and booked-call numbers after a few months on their main accounts, with no restrictions. Or a straight explanation of the actual send limits and what happens to my account if Instagram flags it, ideally with a way to run it on a secondary account first.
